notes: Info mode title for the moon on the HUD.

en: The moon comes after several tides. Tides ebb with pull and pushes.
pt-BR: A lua vem depois de várias marés. As marés recuam com puxões e empurrões.
notes: Info mode, about the moon. Pull and push are the two tide moves.
fr: La lune arrive après plusieurs marées. Tirer et pousser font refluer les marées.
de: Der Mond kommt nach mehreren Gezeiten. Gezeiten weichen durch Ziehen und Schieben.
pl: Księżyc przychodzi po kilku przypływach. Pływy cofają się od przyciągania i pchnięć.

notes: Info mode, about the moon at night.
Info mode title for the gold bar that counts the planet constellations drawn in ink at night.

en: Planets drawn in ink under the moon: {$planets} of {$all}. Something stirs when every one is drawn.
pt-BR: Planetas desenhados com tinta sob a lua: {$planets} de {$all}. Algo desperta quando todos estiverem desenhados.
notes: Info mode, about the constellation bar. A hint at the secret ending; keep it vague. {$planets} is how many, {$all} is 9.
fr: Planètes tracées à l'encre sous la lune : {$planets} sur {$all}. Quelque chose s'éveille quand toutes sont tracées.
de: Mit Tinte unter dem Mond gezeichnete Planeten: {$planets} von {$all}. Sind alle gezeichnet, regt sich etwas.
pl: Planety narysowane atramentem pod księżycem: {$planets} z {$all}. Gdy narysujesz wszystkie, coś się przebudzi.

notes: Info mode title for the gold bar that counts the parts of a trident drawn as constellations in ink at night.

en: Parts of the trident drawn in the stars: {$parts} of {$all}. Something stirs when it is whole.
pt-BR: Partes do tridente desenhadas nas estrelas: {$parts} de {$all}. Algo desperta quando ele estiver completo.
notes: Info mode, about the trident bar. A hint at the secret ending; keep it vague. {$parts} is how many, {$all} is 5.
fr: Parties du trident tracées dans les étoiles : {$parts} sur {$all}. Quelque chose s'éveille quand il est entier.
de: Teile des Dreizacks, in die Sterne gezeichnet: {$parts} von {$all}. Ist er ganz, regt sich etwas.
pl: Części trójzębu narysowane w gwiazdach: {$parts} z {$all}. Gdy będzie cały, coś się przebudzi.

notes: Info mode title for the gold bar that counts the constellations drawn in ink at night. Do not name the shape: it is a secret.

en: Drawn in the stars: {$parts} of {$all}. Something stirs when it is whole.
pt-BR: Desenhadas nas estrelas: {$parts} de {$all}. Algo desperta quando ela estiver completa.
notes: Info mode, about the bar. A hint at the secret ending; keep it vague, and do not name the shape. {$parts} is how many, {$all} is 5.
fr: Tracés dans les étoiles : {$parts} sur {$all}. Quelque chose s'éveille quand elle est entière.
de: In die Sterne gezeichnet: {$parts} von {$all}. Ist sie ganz, regt sich etwas.
pl: Narysowane w gwiazdach: {$parts} z {$all}. Gdy będzie cała, coś się przebudzi.

en: Painted in ink: {$parts} of {$all}. Something stirs when it is whole.
pt-BR: Pintadas com tinta: {$parts} de {$all}. Algo desperta quando ela estiver completa.
notes: Info mode: the words under tide.godly, the gold bar that counts the shapes painted in ink at night. {$parts} and {$all} are numbers. Do not name the shape: it is a secret. The shapes are painted in ink on the board, never drawn in the stars. Replaces tide.godly.desc.
fr: Peints à l'encre : {$parts} sur {$all}. Quelque chose s'éveille quand elle est entière.
de: Mit Tinte gemalt: {$parts} von {$all}. Ist sie ganz, regt sich etwas.
pl: Namalowane atramentem: {$parts} z {$all}. Gdy będzie cała, coś się przebudzi.

notes: Info mode title for the row of little pips beside the board in the day, one for each cell of ink left from the night. 'Pot' as in the money at stake in a bet. Fits about 110 px.

en: A pip for every cell of ink, at its most. Wash every bit of it off the board to cash in: the bigger the pot, the bigger the pay. Night washes it away for next to nothing.
pt-BR: Uma marca para cada casa de tinta, no máximo que já houve. Lave toda a tinta do tabuleiro para receber: quanto maior a bolada, maior o prêmio. A noite a lava por quase nada.
notes: Info mode: the words under tide.inkpot. Wraps in the info box; two or three short sentences. The ink left at dawn stays on the board; popping a fish on an inked cell washes it off. The pot is the most ink there has been at once, and pays out (growing faster the bigger it is) only once ALL the ink is gone. If night falls first, the ink is washed away for a tiny score.
fr: Un point par case d'encre, au plus fort. Lave toute l'encre du plateau pour encaisser : plus la cagnotte est grosse, plus elle rapporte. La nuit l'emporte pour presque rien.
de: Ein Punkt für jedes Tintenfeld, beim Höchststand. Wasch die ganze Tinte vom Spielfeld, um zu kassieren: je größer der Pott, desto mehr gibt es. Die Nacht wäscht sie fast umsonst weg.
pl: Jeden znacznik za każde pole atramentu, w szczytowym momencie. Zmyj cały atrament z planszy, by zgarnąć pulę: im większa, tym więcej płaci. Noc zmywa go prawie za darmo.
